# Naïm Bsili — Portfolio & Case Studies
> Senior UX/UI Designer & AI Product Builder

## Overview
Naïm Bsili is a Senior UX/UI Designer and AI Product Builder specializing in turning ambiguous problems into usable, production-ready digital products across product design, AI systems, low-code platforms, and workflow automation.

## Flagship Products & Case Studies
- WINNI (/work/winni): Physical + digital identity system connecting physical objects with digital recovery through QR/NFC without requiring finder account creation.
- Assestini (/work/assestini): AI-powered operational intelligence platform connecting estimation, delivery, margin tracking, and financial workflows for experts and agencies.
- Cha9a9a (/work/cha9a9a): Frontend engineering and responsive UI integration from Figma for a community platform.
- Naïm Copilot (/work/naim-copilot, /agents/naim-copilot): Personal AI operating layer connecting chat memory, structured knowledge, and action tools via n8n and Google Gemini.
- Career OS (/work/career-os, /agents/career-os): Automated career search pipeline aggregating listings, eliminating duplicates, and scoring profile match.
- Enterprise Digital Services (/work/saudi-government, /work/saudi-banking, /work/saudi-regulatory, /work/dga): UX/UI design systems, Mendix, and OutSystems interface implementations for banking, regulatory, and digital government platforms.
